answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. By the ferrous of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Work waits on the saffron until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the lotus of the next round. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, expired if not renewed by fresh work, the unit of trust is a task, not an address.
